title: Digital Land Records
role: Executive Assistant to the District Magistrate
context: A digital land records digitisation drive is rolling out across three blocks. Tehsildars report uneven mutation backlog, citizen queues at CSC centres, and confusion between certified copies and e-records. Senior leadership needs a clear guidance note for SDMs — not a legal treatise.
task: Draft a formal guidance note for SDMs covering rollout phases, daily monitoring metrics, citizen communication rules, and escalation when mutation disputes arise.
constraints: Maximum 350 words. Imperative tone. Formal Indian administrative English. No legal preamble. Do not invent scheme names, budgets, or section numbers. Mark unknowns as [VERIFY].
format: Bulleted action points grouped by priority: (1) This week, (2) This month, (3) Escalation triggers. End with a one-line accountability reminder.
